comment: The Watchlist wave-3 capture list: each ui-sim capture, the board it answers, the dev triggers armed in a fresh instance root, the mock state and the keys it sends. ONE CAPTURE RECIPE, automated by tools/watchlist_captures.py (`python3 tools/watchlist_captures.py --sim <plxnative-sim> [--out DIR] [--only FILE ...]`): (1) tests/mock_pms.py starts in that process on loopback with authorize_after=2, and `POST /_mock/discover {"list": <mock>}` resets its Discover list to the capture's `mock` mode (`default` is the 14-title fixture, `empty` clears the list, `movies_only` keeps only the movie titles so Type = TV Shows matches nothing); (2) a fresh instance root gets `plxnative-plextv` and `plxnative-discover` aimed at the mock, and a prep boot with `plxnative-login` signs in through the app's own QR flow - the stored mock session is the account, so no `token` trigger is armed (a `token` boot reads the Watchlist as unavailable for the profile); (3) the capture's `triggers` are armed, the simulator boots, waits `boot_wait_s`, sends each `keys` entry as a FIFO token through `plxnative-remote` with `key_wait_s` between them (`hold` is `okdown`, 1.2 s, `okup`), checks `expect_focus` and then sends `shot`. A capture REACHES its target by an accessibility-id token, or by a boot trigger, and never by a direction key: no `keys` entry is `up`, `down`, `left` or `right`. `focus:<id>` moves focus to the element an id names (`nav.watchlist`, `watchlist.grid.card.7`, `home.shelf.2.card.0`) and `press:<id>` focuses it and presses OK (ids are the app's place-based dot paths, grammar in tools/a11y.py; a malformed one fails the run before anything boots). A press of an element that acts on a title it names (the ids are `SUBJECT_BEARING` in tools/a11y.py) names that title, `press:<id>@<ratingKey>`, the ratingKey of the title the press acts on, and the app refuses it when another title is there: `press:itemmenu.watchlist_remove@2001` (The Long Meridian, the mock's second Watchlist title) and `press:home.hero.watchlist@200622` (the first Continue Watching episode of the `catalog` mock) and `press:detail.hero.watchlist@1001` (the Detail page of Harbor Lights, the `first_movie_off` mock's first movie); the one bare title press is `watchlist.grid.card.7`, a coming-soon card with no key. The keys that stay are those whose subject is the key itself: `hold`, a timing such as `ok@0.12`, `back`; and the one capture that navigates by pointer, `w6/detail-offline.png`, whose `ck:<x>,<y>` clicks are its walk. `expect_focus` is the full id the app must have focused when the walk is done: the driver asks the app for a `state:` snapshot and fails the capture, naming both ids, when it differs (a walk that ends in a timed key is checked before that key, because the shot must follow it within the wait). A capture whose focus a boot trigger decides (an opener row: `account-menu-new.png`, `item-menu-new.png`) or a pointer click does (`w6/detail-offline.png`) leaves it out, and a refused id (`a11y: refused ...` in the event log) fails the capture either way. A `hold` on a tile (a Watchlist tile, a Home shelf card) opens its menu, so a hold capture's `expect_focus` is the menu's opening row (`itemmenu.<row>`); (4) the instance root's shot-N.png becomes `<output_dir>/<file>`, and a capture with `expect_write` fails unless the mock logged that write. `compare` names a baseline PNG (651035609 built the same way in a separate worktree) for the reader to put beside the new capture; the driver does not diff it. Build the simulator with `make sim-macos SIM_TDIR=<dir outside the checkout>` (debug; the release build serves as well). Nothing reaches plex.tv, a real server or a television. The PNGs are scratch output, never committed. WAVE 6 (Bump B) captures live under `w6/`: `board` names the Design board each answers; `mock_extra` is merged into the Discover reset (`guids: all` gives every library title a Discover guid so a card's menu offers Add), `unreachable` aims plex.tv at a closed port after the sign-in (the plex.tv-unreachable Detail), and a key `k@0.12` waits 0.12 s instead of key_wait_s (the mid-flip shot); `mock:<json>` POSTs <json> to /_mock/discover mid-walk, `sleep:<s>` waits, and `ck:<x>,<y>` clicks at logical 1920x1080 pixels. DetailOffline is the catalog page of a title matched on the mock server that then went away: the Watchlist matches Harbor Lights, `{"pms":"fail"}` makes every PMS request answer 503, a click on Movies makes the library read fail (its failure is what commits the server Unreachable), a click on the Watchlist tab reads the list again (the read re-derives the tiles: ServerOffline), and a click on the first tile opens its catalog page. Run it from a release AND a debug simulator and grep each <file>.log/.out for `panic`. HOME HERO captures live under `home-hero/` and answer the HomeHero board (canvas v44): the hero row's bookmark disc, second after Continue/Play, focused (`focus:home.hero.watchlist`, the hero's bookmark control); `heropin 0` holds the first hero and `mock_extra episode_shows: catalog` points every episode's show at the first catalogued show (The Long Meridian: on the `default` list, off the `empty` one), so the Continue Watching hero has a title the Discover stand-in knows. W-NOTIFY (library add flips a tile live) lives in `library-add-flips-tile.png`: the Watchlist tab stays open, `lib:{"op":"add","title":"Northbound Tide"}` makes the mock library hold a title the list carries as coming soon and pushes the `timeline` frame a server would send (the captured three-frame add sequence; only its finished frame owes the re-match), the tile flips from Coming soon to its on-your-servers face with no key pressed (the re-match waits for the feed to be quiet for 10 s, so the walk sleeps 14 s after the add), and `expect_log` fails the capture unless the app logged the library re-match.

captures.board: (no board: the plex.tv-unreachable Detail, outline face)

baseline: 651035609 built the same way in a separate worktree and target dir; the *-base.png files
